system: (3,3) single-wall carbon nanotube (diameter about 4 A): 12 C atoms per cell, period c = 2.4477 A along the tube axis z, 13 A of vacuum; LDA, norm-conserving PseudoDojo pseudopotential, 100 Ry; Quantum ESPRESSO 7.3 (DFPT) and EPW with two Wannier bands around the Fermi level.
source: E. Marazzi, S. Ponce, J.-C. Charlier, G.-M. Rignanese, Materials Cloud Archive record vs5fd-dbv98 (DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:yx-x1, CC BY 4.0). All data are retrieved author results; the self_energy evaluator recomputes self-energies from the archived coupling tables.
nesting_wavevector: All coupling and self-energy data refer to one phonon wavevector Q = 0.424 (units of 2 pi / c) along the tube axis.
modes_at_Q: 36 phonon branches, numbered at Q from the lowest frequency. Coupling data, archived self-energy tables and the evaluator cover nu = 1 (radial breathing mode, RBM), nu = 20 and nu = 23 (in-plane optical A1 modes).

units.energy: meV for phonon frequencies, self-energies and couplings; eV for electron energies

archive_file.returns: the verbatim text of one small archive file

archive_files.dft_inputs/epw.in: EPW input of the Wannier / electron-phonon run
archive_files.dft_inputs/specfun/epw.in: EPW input template of the phonon self-energy (spectral function) runs
archive_files.dft_inputs/specfun/input.py: script that generated the self-energy runs from the template
archive_files.dft_inputs/specfun/pathq.dat: q-point list of the self-energy runs
archive_files.Fig1/coupling_calculator.c: source of the analytic 1D model of Fig. 1 (threshold coupling)

bands.returns: DFT band structure from Fig2/e_band/band.eig: 12 bands at 5000 k along the tube axis (k in units of 2 pi / alat, alat = 13.0 A), eV, with the Fermi-level line of the authors' band-plot script (fig2_a_b.py) quoted verbatim

phonons.returns: DFPT phonon dispersion from Fig2/ph_band/matdyn.freq: 36 branches at 1001 q from Gamma along the tube axis (q in units of 2 pi / alat), cm-1

coupling.returns: the archived EPW coupling tables Fig2/g/g+q.<n m nu> and g-q.<n m nu> for one mode: uniform 2000-point k grid (crystal units, -0.5 <= k < 0.5); energies (eV) of the two Wannier bands at k and at k+Q (or k-Q), ordered by energy at each k as in the archive; omega_Q (meV); |g_mn(k)| (meV) for the band pairs (n, m), n at k and m at k+-Q; plus a comment quoted from the authors' coupling-plot script

dfpt_scan.returns: DFPT frequencies at Q of nu = 1, 20, 23 computed with Fermi-Dirac smearing sigma = 10, 5, 3, 2, 1, 0.5 mRy, as tabulated in the authors' Fig. 2 script (their "Eq. (1)" curves), cm-1

self_energy_table.returns: the archived EPW phonon self-energy file Fig2/PiT/<T> for one mode: its two header lines and its 801 data lines (frequencies w from -500 to 150 meV), verbatim. Tables at other temperatures exist in the archive but are withheld.

format.band_pairs: non-empty list of distinct [n, m], n and m in {1, 2}

self_energy.returns: Re and Im of Pi_nu(w, T) (meV) at the requested frequencies
self_energy.definition: For one process p (k -> k+Q or k -> k-Q): Pi(w, T) = (2/N_k) sum_k sum_(n,m) |g_mn(k)|^2 [f(e_m(k+pQ)) - f(e_n(k))] / [e_m(k+pQ) - e_n(k) - w - i eta]; the result is summed over the selected processes and band pairs. f is the Fermi-Dirac function at temperature_K with the chemical potential fixed at -1.0380 eV (fermi_energy of the archived EPW self-energy input). The archived 2000-point bands and |g|^2 are linearly interpolated onto nk uniform k-points after the two bands have been followed through their crossings; band_pairs use the archive's energy ordering (1 = lower band) at each k.
self_energy.sign_convention: Re Pi < 0 softens the mode; Im Pi(w > 0) < 0.
